site_title: Pass the Baton: passing it on is leadership
meta_description: What applies to the people should apply to those who lead them. A global, non-violent, non-partisan movement for renewal at the top.
hero_lead: All over the world, people hand their work to the next generation at a certain age. We ask the people who lead countries to do the same. Not out of distrust of older people, but out of respect for renewal.
baton_alt: A lifelike amber relay baton crossing the exchange zone
fact_offices: of {total} top office holders at or above the norm
big67_label: the latest age for starting a new term
demand_text: Anyone who has reached the statutory retirement age of their own country, and at the latest 67, does not start a new term in one of the highest offices.
demand_notes: It applies worldwide, in every country and under every regime, starting with heads of state, heads of government and ministers. A term already under way may be completed. Ordinary citizens remain free to keep working.
gap_title: Leaders and the people they lead
gap_note: Calculated on {date} from the sourced profiles on the countries page. Bars run from 0 to 90 years.
why_title: Why the baton has to move
why1_text: A nurse, a builder or a teacher hands over their work. Those who decide over millions of lives often stay until the very end.
why2_text: Decisions on climate, debt and pensions mostly affect generations who will bear the consequences themselves.
why3_text: Those who never leave make no room for new ideas, new people and new energy.
why4_text: As adviser, mentor or ambassador. Passing the baton is an act of leadership, not a defeat.
handover_alt: An older hand passing a lifelike amber relay baton to a younger hand
quote: Passing the baton is an act of leadership, not a defeat.
countries_text: For every country we record who holds the highest offices, their age and the country's statutory retirement age, each with its source.
countries_empty: The first country profiles are being researched.
join_text: Hand a baton to someone, in real life or online, and share it with #PassTheBaton. Non-violent, non-partisan and open to everyone.
footer_text: Pass the Baton is non-violent, non-partisan and open source. No tracking, no cookies.

cp_meta_description: Leaders of the highest offices compared with their country's retirement age, with a source for every fact.
cp_intro: For each country: who holds the highest offices, their age, and the country's statutory retirement age. The norm for a new term is that retirement age, at the latest 67. This page states facts; it does not judge anyone. Every value links to its source.
cp_monarchs: Kings and queens are included too. They have no terms, but the same principle applies: what holds for the people holds for those who lead them.
cp_legend_norm: the norm for a new term
cp_footnote: Ages calculated on {date}. Bars run from 0 to 90 years. Profiles are researched by an AI agent with web search, reviewed by a person before publication, and refreshed regularly.
jp_meta_description: Join Pass the Baton: talk, organise and help the movement grow on Discord and Reddit.
jp_intro: Pass the Baton grows one handover at a time. Join the conversation, help with translations and research, or organise an action where you live.
jp_discord_text: Channels per language and country, for translators, researchers and the yearly action day. This is where the movement is built.
jp_reddit_text: Share news, ask questions and test the arguments. Every view is welcome, as long as we debate ideas, not people.
jp_ways_title: Three things you can do today
jp_way1_text: Hand a baton, or anything that stands for one, to someone of another generation. Share the photo with #PassTheBaton.
jp_way2_text: Check a translation, or help translate the manifesto and this website into a language that is still missing.
jp_way3_title: Check the facts for your country
jp_way3_text: Look at your country on the countries page and tell us if anything is out of date.
jp_safety_text: In some countries, taking part in a political movement carries real risk. Use a nickname, don't share personal details in public channels, and only do what is safe where you live.
jp_privacy: Pass the Baton does not collect your name or e-mail address on this website. Discord and Reddit handle your account under their own privacy policies.
ap_meta_description: Who we are, how we work and what we stand for: a global, non-violent and non-partisan movement of volunteers.
ap_intro: Pass the Baton is a global, non-violent and non-partisan movement of volunteers. We ask one thing: what applies to the people should apply to those who lead them.
ap_why_text: All over the world, people hand their work to the next generation at a certain age. Yet many of those who decide over millions of lives stay in office far beyond it. We believe renewal at the top is healthy for every country, and that passing the baton is an act of leadership, not a defeat.
ap_how1_text: Our texts, data and code are public. Anyone can read how the movement is built, suggest changes or start a local version.
ap_how2_text: AI agents help with research, translations and design. Nothing goes out in the movement's name until a person has reviewed and approved it.
ap_how3_text: Each figure on our countries page links to where it comes from. If something is wrong or out of date, anyone can tell us and we correct it.
ap_not_text: We are not a political party and we support no candidates. We are not against older people: experience stays valuable, as adviser, mentor or ambassador. We do not mock anyone's age or health, and we never use or call for violence.
ap_who_text: Volunteers from different countries and generations. There is no leader on a pedestal here: the idea is to pass the baton, and that applies to us too.
ap_money_text: We keep costs low and take no money from parties or governments. When we start raising funds, for example by selling physical batons, every euro in and out will be public.
ap_contact_text: The quickest way to reach us is on Discord. Spotted an error on the site? Tell us on GitHub. Journalists can ask for a contact person on Discord.
